what: Create Interactive Highchart Graph with Categories and Groups — make_hist
title: Create Interactive Highchart Graph with Categories and Groups — make_hist
text: Creates customizable interactive graph using highcharter support multiple groups, different chart types (column/line), Norwegian health survey styling. Includes automatic color assignment, hover effects, export functionality.

title: Create Interactive Highchart Graph with Categories and Groups — make_hist
code: make_hist(   d,   x,   y,   group,   n = NULL,   title = "Title is here",   subtitle = NULL,   yint = 10,   ylim = NULL,   xtitle = NULL,   ytitle = NULL,   flip = FALSE,   type = "column",   line_symbols = NULL,   dot_size = 4,   smooth = TRUE,   filename = NULL,   caption = "Tall om alkohol" )

title: Create Interactive Highchart Graph with Categories and Groups — make_hist
text: d data.frame data.table. input dataset containing variables plot. x Unquoted variable name. x-axis variable (categories). y Unquoted variable name. y-axis variable (values, typically percentages). group Unquoted variable name. grouping variable creating multiple series. n Unquoted variable name. count variable display tooltips (raw numbers). Default NULL (counts shown). title Character string. Main title chart. subtitle Character string, optional. Subtitle chart. NULL, defaults "Kilde: Navn av kilder". Default NULL. yint Numeric. Interval y-axis tick marks. Default 10. ylim Numeric vector length 2, optional. Sets fixed y-axis limits c(min, max). NULL (default), y-axis limits determined automatically data. Example: c(0, 70) sets y-axis 0 70. xtitle Character string, optional. X-axis title. NULL (default), title shown. ytitle Character string, optional. Y-axis title. NULL (default), title shown. flip Logical. Whether flip chart orientation (horizontal bars). Default FALSE. type Character string. Chart type, either "column" "line". Default "column". line_symbols Character vector, optional. Symbols line markers type="line". match number groups. Available symbols: "circle", "square", "diamond", "triangle", "triangle-". NULL, uses different symbols group automatically. Default NULL. dot_size Numeric. Size (radius pixels) markers/dots line charts. applies type="line". Default 4. smooth Logical. Whether create smooth spline curves line charts. TRUE, uses "spline" type curved lines points. FALSE, uses straight line segments. applies type="line". Default TRUE. filename Character string. Base filename exported charts (without extension). caption Character string. Caption text displayed chart.

title: Create Interactive Highchart Graph with Categories and Groups — make_hist
text: function automatically handles color assignment based number groups: 2 groups: Custom teal purple palette 3-7 groups: Extended custom palette good contrast 8+ groups: Falls back viridis color scale line charts, different symbols automatically assigned group improve distinguishability, especially important accessibility black--white printing. chart includes several interactive features: Hover effects category highlighting Detailed tooltips showing counts percentages Export functionality (PNG, JPEG, PDF, SVG, CSV, Excel) Norwegian health survey styling credits

title: Create Interactive Highchart Graph with Categories and Groups — make_hist

title: Create Interactive Highchart Graph with Categories and Groups — make_hist
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(highcharter) library(dplyr)  # Sample data survey_data <- data.frame(   age_group = rep(c("18-24", "25-34", "35-44", "45-54"), each = 3),   gender = rep(c("Male", "Female", "Other"), 4),   percentage = runif(12, 10, 80),   count = sample(50:200, 12) )  # Basic column chart make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Survey Results by Age and Gender")  # Chart with fixed y-axis scale make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Fixed Y-axis Scale",           ylim = c(0, 70))  # Smooth line chart with custom symbols and fixed scale make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Smooth Trend Analysis",           type = "line",           smooth = TRUE,           ylim = c(0, 100),           line_symbols = c("circle", "square", "diamond"))  # Regular (angular) line chart make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Angular Line Chart",           type = "line",           smooth = FALSE)  # Horizontal bar chart with fixed scale make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Horizontal View",           flip = TRUE,           ylim = c(0, 50))  # Custom y-axis intervals with fixed scale make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Fine-grained Y-axis",           yint = 5,           ylim = c(0, 60)) } # }
